description: Builds an interactive explorer over census data allowing comparison of demographic indicators across regions. Handles boundary changes between census years, which silently break naive year-on-year comparisons.

title: Nutrition Label Analysis of Packaged Foods
description: Analyses nutritional content across packaged food categories and scores products against dietary guidelines. Normalises per hundred grams rather than per serving, since serving sizes are chosen by manufacturers and are not comparable.

title: Open Data Portal Quality Audit
description: Audits datasets published on an open data portal for completeness, freshness, schema consistency and documentation. Produces a per-dataset scorecard, turning a vague sense that the data is messy into a specific fixable list.

title: Time Series Anomaly Reporting for KPIs
description: Monitors business KPIs and reports statistically unusual movements with the expected range shown alongside. Accounts for weekly and holiday seasonality, without which every Monday triggers an alert.

title: Survey Response Bias Analysis
description: Analyses how non-response and self-selection bias survey results, and applies post-stratification weighting to correct. Shows how much a headline percentage moves after weighting, which is often larger than the reported margin of error.

title: Job Board with Employer Dashboards
description: A job board where employers post vacancies and track applicants through pipeline stages while candidates search and apply. Separates employer and candidate permissions properly, since the same listing endpoint must expose different fields to each role.

title: Real-Time Chat Application with Presence
description: A group chat with typing indicators, read receipts and online presence backed by a publish-subscribe layer. Stores presence with expiry rather than explicit logout events, because browsers frequently close without telling the server.

title: Video Conferencing with WebRTC
description: Browser-to-browser video calling with screen sharing, built on peer connections and a lightweight signalling server. Handles network address translation traversal, which is where most first WebRTC attempts silently fail between different networks.

title: Appointment Booking System for Clinics
description: Lets patients book, reschedule and cancel appointments against real practitioner availability. Prevents double booking under concurrent requests with database-level locking, which optimistic application checks alone cannot guarantee.

title: Restaurant Ordering and Table Management
description: Handles dine-in ordering from table QR codes through to kitchen display and billing. Models the order as an explicit state machine so a dish cannot be served before it is cooked or billed twice.

title: Hotel Reservation Platform
description: Searches room availability across date ranges with dynamic pricing and handles the full reservation lifecycle. Availability across overlapping date ranges is the core difficulty, and naive per-day checks scale badly.

title: Event Ticketing Platform with QR Check-In
description: Sells event tickets with unique QR codes and validates them at the door, marking each as used exactly once. Handles the offline case at venue gates, where connectivity is unreliable precisely when scanning volume peaks.

title: Crowdfunding Platform with Milestones
description: Runs funding campaigns that release funds to creators only as milestones are verified. Models pledged versus collected money separately, since a pledge is a promise and treating the two as one causes accounting errors.

title: Freelance Marketplace with Escrow
description: Connects clients and freelancers with milestone-based escrow, deliverable submission and a dispute process. The dispute workflow is the hard part, since it must freeze funds without freezing the working relationship.

title: Property Listing Portal with Map Search
description: Lists properties with map-based search, radius filtering and saved searches with alerts. Uses geospatial indexing so map-bounds queries stay fast as the listing count grows.

title: Online Auction Platform with Live Bidding
description: Runs timed auctions with live bid updates, proxy bidding and anti-sniping time extensions. Serialises bids strictly, because two bids arriving in the same millisecond must still produce one unambiguous winner.

title: Recipe Sharing Community with Ratings
description: A community site for publishing recipes with ingredient search, ratings and personal collections. Normalises ingredient names so a search for spring onion also finds recipes calling them scallions.

title: Habit Tracker with Streaks and Reminders
description: Tracks daily habits with streak counters, completion calendars and configurable reminders. Handles timezone changes and late-night completions, which naive date arithmetic breaks in ways users notice immediately.

title: Personal Portfolio Site Generator
description: Generates a personal portfolio website from a structured profile file, with several themes and static export. Produces plain static output so the result can be hosted anywhere without a running server.

title: URL Shortener with Analytics
description: Shortens URLs and records click analytics by referrer, country and device. Caches hot redirects in memory, since redirect latency is the single quality measure that matters for this service.

title: Pastebin-Style Code Snippet Sharing
description: Shares code snippets with syntax highlighting, optional expiry and private links. Implements expiry as a stored deadline checked on read rather than a scheduled job, which is simpler and cannot leak stale content.

title: Markdown-Based Documentation Site Engine
description: Builds a documentation site from a folder of markdown files with automatic navigation and client-side search. Generates the search index at build time so search works with no backend at all.

title: Kanban Project Management Board
description: A drag-and-drop task board with columns, labels, assignees and live multi-user updates. Resolves conflicting simultaneous card moves deterministically, so two users dragging the same card do not corrupt the ordering.

title: Issue Tracker with Workflow States
description: Tracks issues through configurable workflow states with assignment, comments and audit history. Enforces valid state transitions server-side, since a client that offers only legal buttons is not a security boundary.

title: Time Tracking and Invoicing Tool
description: Tracks billable hours per client and project, then generates invoices with tax handling and PDF export. Stores immutable invoice snapshots, because an invoice that changes when a rate is edited is a bookkeeping disaster.

title: Customer Support Ticketing Portal
description: Manages support tickets with priorities, service level timers, canned replies and full-text search. Pauses service level timers while awaiting customer reply, without which every metric blames the support team unfairly.

title: Newsletter Subscription and Campaign Sender
description: Manages subscriber lists, composes campaigns from templates and sends in throttled batches. Handles bounces and unsubscribes properly, since ignoring them destroys sender reputation within a few sends.

title: Survey and Form Builder
description: Lets users build forms with branching logic, then collects and analyses responses. Stores the form schema with each response so historical answers remain interpretable after the form is edited.

title: Online Quiz Platform with Timed Tests
description: Runs timed online quizzes with question randomisation, auto-grading and attempt limits. Enforces the timer server-side, because a client-side countdown is trivially defeated by anyone who opens developer tools.

title: Library Management System
description: Manages a library catalogue with member records, loans, returns, reservations and fine calculation. Models the loan as an event history rather than a mutable status field, which makes overdue reporting straightforward.

title: Inventory Management for Small Businesses
description: Tracks stock levels across locations with purchase orders, adjustments and low-stock alerts. Derives current stock from an immutable movement ledger, so any discrepancy can be traced to a specific transaction.

title: Point of Sale System for Retail Counters
description: Runs a retail checkout that continues working during internet outages and syncs sales when connectivity returns. Assigns sale identifiers locally so offline transactions never collide with those created elsewhere.

title: Payroll Management System
description: Calculates salaries with allowances, deductions and tax slabs, and generates payslips with a full audit trail. Recomputes from stored rules rather than storing only results, so a retrospective correction can be explained line by line.

title: Hospital Patient Records Portal
description: Manages patient demographics, visits, prescriptions and lab results with strict role-based access. Logs every record view, not only edits, because in clinical systems inappropriate access is the more common violation.

title: School Attendance and Grade Portal
description: Records attendance and grades with separate views for teachers, students and parents. Computes attendance percentage against sessions actually held, not calendar days, which is the source of most disputes.

title: Alumni Networking Platform
description: Connects graduates through profiles, mentorship matching and event announcements. Gives members granular control over which profile fields are visible to whom, since a directory without privacy controls goes unused.

title: Discussion Forum with Threaded Replies
description: A forum with nested reply threads, voting, moderation queues and full-text search. Stores thread hierarchy with materialised paths, which keeps deep threads readable without recursive queries per page load.

title: Q&A Site with Reputation System
description: A question and answer site with voting, accepted answers, tags and reputation-gated privileges. Designs reputation to reward useful answers rather than volume, since the naive version rewards fastest-first posting.

title: Podcast Hosting and RSS Generator
description: Hosts podcast episodes and generates a compliant RSS feed for directory distribution. Feed correctness is unforgiving, since a single malformed element makes an entire show disappear from listening apps.

title: Music Playlist Sharing Application
description: Lets users build, share and collaboratively edit playlists with search across a track catalogue. Tracks playlist edit attribution so collaborators can see who added or removed what.

title: Photo Gallery with Albums and Sharing
description: Organises photographs into albums with thumbnails, tagging and shareable links. Generates multiple image sizes at upload rather than resizing per request, which is the difference between a fast and an unusable gallery.

title: File Sharing with Expiring Links
description: Shares files through links that expire by time or download count, with optional password protection. Streams uploads and downloads rather than buffering, so large files do not exhaust server memory.

title: Password Manager Web Vault
description: Stores credentials encrypted in the browser so the server never sees plaintext or the master key. Derives keys client-side with a slow key derivation function, which is what makes a stolen database useless to an attacker.

title: Bookmark Manager with Tagging
description: Saves and organises bookmarks with tags, full-text search and browser export import. Fetches page titles and descriptions automatically, since bookmarks saved without context become unsearchable within weeks.

title: Weather Dashboard with Location Search
description: Shows current conditions and forecasts for searched locations with charts for temperature and precipitation. Caches upstream responses per location, because weather APIs bill per call and forecasts change slowly.

title: Currency Converter with Rate History
description: Converts between currencies and charts historical rate movements over selectable periods. Stores fetched rates locally so historical charts remain available and consistent even when the upstream API changes.

title: Flight Search Aggregator Interface
description: Aggregates flight results from several providers into one ranked list with filters for stops and duration. Merges duplicate itineraries offered by multiple providers, which otherwise fill the results page with the same flight.

title: Travel Itinerary Planner
description: Plans multi-day trips with activities, transport and accommodation on a shared timeline. Detects impossible schedules where travel time between two activities exceeds the gap between them.

title: Charity Donation Platform with Receipts
description: Accepts one-off and recurring donations, issues tax receipts and reports campaign progress. Makes donation records immutable and reconciles against payment provider settlements rather than trusting callbacks alone.

title: Real-Time Sports Score Dashboard
description: Displays live match scores and statistics that update without a page refresh. Pushes only changed fields rather than full payloads, which keeps the dashboard responsive on slow mobile connections.

title: Medication Reminder App with Adherence Tracking
description: Reminds patients to take medication on schedule and records what was actually taken. Schedules notifications locally so reminders still fire without connectivity, which is exactly when they are most needed.

title: Meditation and Breathing Exercise App
description: Guides breathing exercises with paced animation and audio, tracking session history and streaks. Keeps the animation running smoothly under screen dimming, since a stuttering pacer defeats the entire purpose.

title: Sleep Quality Tracker
description: Estimates sleep duration and disturbance from phone motion and ambient sound overnight. Batches sensor sampling to limit battery drain, because an app that drains the battery overnight gets uninstalled the next day.

title: Water Intake Reminder
description: Tracks daily water consumption against a personalised goal with adaptive reminders. Suppresses reminders during sleeping hours, a small detail that determines whether notifications stay enabled.

title: Calorie and Nutrition Logger
description: Logs meals against a food database and reports macronutrient breakdown over time. Caches frequently logged foods locally, since logging must take seconds or users abandon it within a week.

title: Language Vocabulary Trainer with Spaced Repetition
description: Teaches vocabulary using a spaced repetition schedule that adapts to what the learner keeps forgetting. Runs entirely offline, because the commute where people study is often exactly where signal is worst.

title: Public Transport Live Timetable App
description: Shows live departure times for nearby stops with service alerts and journey planning. Falls back to the scheduled timetable when live data is unavailable, clearly labelled so users know which they are seeing.

title: Ride Sharing Booking App
description: Books rides by matching passengers to nearby drivers with live tracking and fare estimation. Handles driver location updates efficiently, since naive per-second writes for every driver overwhelm the database quickly.

title: Food Delivery Tracking App
description: Places food orders and tracks preparation and delivery with live courier position. Models order state explicitly so the customer-visible status can never move backwards after a transient network error.

title: Grocery List with Shared Households
description: A shared shopping list that syncs instantly between household members and works offline. Merges concurrent edits so two people shopping in different aisles do not overwrite each other's ticks.

title: Barcode Price Comparison Shopper
description: Scans a product barcode in store and compares prices across nearby and online retailers. Caches recent lookups so repeated scans of the same item in a shop do not repeatedly hit the network.

title: Personal Budget App with Envelope Method
description: Implements envelope budgeting where income is allocated to spending categories before it is spent. Enforces that allocations cannot exceed income, which is the constraint that makes the method work at all.

title: Parking Spot Finder App
description: Finds available parking near a destination with pricing, walking distance and navigation handoff. Ranks by total time to destination including the walk, rather than by distance to the parking itself.

title: Campus Navigation App
description: Navigates students between campus buildings and rooms, including indoor floor-level routing. Ships maps offline, since building interiors are exactly where satellite positioning and mobile signal both fail.

title: Attendance Marking App with Geofencing
description: Marks attendance automatically when a student is physically inside the classroom geofence during class time. Includes basic location spoofing checks, without which the app measures willingness to install a mock GPS app.

title: Field Data Collection App for Surveys
description: Collects survey responses in the field with no connectivity and syncs when the device returns to network. Queues submissions durably so a closed app or flat battery never loses a completed form.

title: Offline Maps for Hiking Trails
description: Downloads map tiles for offline use and records hiking routes with elevation profile. Manages tile storage limits explicitly, since an unbounded offline cache fills the device and gets the app uninstalled.

title: Wildlife Sighting Reporting App
description: Lets citizen scientists record wildlife sightings with photograph, location and species. Obscures precise locations for endangered species, because published coordinates have been used to find and poach animals.

title: Emergency SOS Alert App
description: Sends location and an alert to chosen contacts when triggered, including from a locked screen. Retries delivery over multiple channels, since the situations that trigger it are exactly those with poor connectivity.

title: Women Safety App with Trusted Contacts
description: Shares live location with trusted contacts during a journey and alerts them if check-in is missed. Uses timed check-ins rather than only a panic button, since a user may be unable to reach the phone at all.

title: Blood Donor Matching App
description: Matches urgent blood requests to nearby compatible donors and notifies them. Rate-limits requests per donor, because donors who receive constant alerts stop responding to any of them.

title: Farmer Market Price App
description: Shows current crop prices at nearby markets so farmers can decide where and when to sell. Works in local languages and caches the last known prices, since rural connectivity is intermittent.

title: Livestock Health Record App
description: Keeps per-animal health records including vaccination, treatment and breeding history with reminders. Identifies animals by tag number with photo backup, since tags are frequently lost or become unreadable.

title: Home Inventory and Warranty Tracker
description: Catalogues household possessions with purchase date, receipt photograph and warranty expiry reminders. Exports the full inventory for insurance claims, which is the moment the data actually earns its keep.

title: Fuel Consumption and Trip Log App
description: Logs refuelling and journeys to compute real fuel economy and running cost per kilometre. Detects partial fills, which silently corrupt economy calculations in most fuel tracking apps.

title: Reading Progress Tracker for Books
description: Tracks reading progress across books with session logging, pace estimates and annual goals. Estimates finish dates from actual reading pace rather than an assumed constant rate.

title: Podcast Player with Offline Downloads
description: Subscribes to podcast feeds, downloads episodes for offline listening and remembers playback position. Manages storage automatically by removing finished episodes, which otherwise silently consume gigabytes.

title: Habit Streak Widget App
description: Tracks habits from a home screen widget so completion takes one tap without opening the app. Handles timezone travel correctly, since a naive implementation breaks streaks across a flight.

title: Local Events Discovery App
description: Discovers nearby events filtered by interest, date and distance with calendar integration. Learns from saved and attended events to rank future suggestions rather than showing everything chronologically.

title: Second-Hand Marketplace App
description: Lists second-hand goods with photographs, in-app chat and location-based browsing. Keeps buyer and seller contact details private until both agree, which is the main safety control in peer marketplaces.

title: Smart Energy Meter with Load Disaggregation
description: Measures household power draw and infers which appliances are running from their switching signatures. Disaggregation from a single meter point is what avoids installing a sensor on every circuit, and it is the hard part.

title: Cold Chain Temperature Monitoring
description: Logs temperature along a refrigerated supply chain and alerts on excursions that would spoil goods. Buffers readings locally during connectivity gaps, since a gap in the record is itself a compliance failure.

title: Industrial Machine Vibration Monitoring
description: Monitors machine vibration and flags bearing wear from changes in the frequency spectrum. Analyses in the frequency domain on the device, because streaming raw high-rate accelerometer data over the network is impractical.

title: Smart Water Tank Level Controller
description: Measures water tank level and controls the pump automatically with dry-run protection. Includes a hardware interlock independent of software, because a hung controller must not be able to burn out the pump.

title: Greenhouse Climate Control System
description: Regulates greenhouse temperature, humidity and light using sensor feedback driving vents, fans and lamps. Applies hysteresis to actuator switching, without which relays chatter continuously around the setpoint.

title: Aquaponics Monitoring System
description: Monitors pH, dissolved oxygen, temperature and nutrient levels in a coupled fish and plant system. Handles sensor drift with scheduled recalibration prompts, since pH probes degrade steadily and silently.

title: Poultry Farm Environment Monitor
description: Tracks ammonia, temperature and humidity in poultry sheds and controls ventilation accordingly. Alerts on rate of change as well as absolute level, because a fast rise signals a ventilation failure before limits are breached.

title: Beehive Health Monitoring
description: Monitors hive weight, temperature and sound to infer colony health and swarming risk. Runs on solar and battery with aggressive duty cycling, since hives sit far from any mains supply.

title: Smart Street Lighting Controller
description: Dims street lights by ambient light and pedestrian presence, and reports failed lamps automatically. Fault reporting saves the manual patrol that currently finds most broken street lights.

title: Waste Bin Fill Level Monitoring
description: Reports public bin fill levels so collection routes visit full bins rather than a fixed schedule. Transmits only on meaningful change, which extends battery life from weeks to months.

title: Noise Pollution Monitoring Network
description: Measures sound levels across a city and maps noise exposure over time. Reports standard weighted metrics rather than raw amplitude, so readings are comparable with regulatory limits.

title: Flood Early Warning Sensor Network
description: Monitors river and drain levels and issues escalating warnings as thresholds are crossed. Designed to fail loudly, since a silent sensor during a flood is indistinguishable from safe conditions.

title: Landslide Detection with Tilt Sensors
description: Detects slope movement using tilt and moisture sensors on unstable hillsides. Distinguishes gradual seasonal creep from accelerating movement, which is what separates a warning from a false alarm.

title: Gas Leak Detection and Shutoff
description: Detects combustible gas leaks and closes a solenoid valve while alerting occupants. Fails to the safe state on power or sensor loss, which is the defining requirement of any safety cutout.

title: Smart Door Lock with Access Logs
description: Controls a door lock via phone or card with per-user permissions and a full access log. Stores credentials hashed and supports offline unlock, because a lock that depends on the internet is a liability.

title: Occupancy-Based HVAC Control
description: Adjusts heating and cooling by room occupancy rather than fixed schedules, and measures the energy saved. Uses presence rather than motion, since motion sensors switch the system off around people sitting still.

title: Asset Tracking with BLE Beacons
description: Tracks equipment inside a building using Bluetooth beacons and fixed receivers. Reports zone-level location rather than coordinates, because signal-strength positioning is not accurate enough to claim more.

title: Livestock Geofencing Collar
description: Tracks grazing animals and alerts when one leaves the permitted area. Reduces position sampling when the animal is well inside the boundary, which multiplies collar battery life.

title: Smart Parking Sensor Grid
description: Detects per-bay occupancy with magnetic or ultrasonic sensors and publishes live availability. Debounces transient readings so a car pausing beside a bay does not mark it occupied.

title: Railway Track Crack Detection
description: Detects rail defects from a trolley-mounted sensor package combining vibration and imaging. Geotags every detection so maintenance crews can return to the exact metre of track.

title: Patient Vitals Monitoring Wearable
description: Continuously monitors heart rate, oxygen saturation and temperature, alerting on clinical thresholds. Filters motion artefacts, which otherwise generate constant false alarms whenever the patient moves.

title: Elderly Fall Detection Device
description: Detects falls from wearable accelerometer patterns and alerts carers if the wearer does not respond. Waits for a cancel window before escalating, because most detected falls are the device being dropped.

title: Soil Moisture Mesh for Large Farms
description: Covers a large field with networked soil moisture probes and interpolates between them to guide irrigation zones. Mesh routing keeps distant nodes connected without running mains power to each one.

title: Solar Inverter Performance Monitor
description: Logs solar generation and compares actual output against expected yield for the current irradiance. Detecting underperformance rather than only failure is what catches gradually soiling or shaded panels.

title: EV Charging Station Management
description: Manages multiple charging points with queueing, load balancing against the site supply limit and per-session billing. Enforces the site limit in hardware terms, since exceeding it trips the whole building.

title: Smart Agriculture Drone Telemetry
description: Streams and stores flight and sensor telemetry from agricultural drones for field analysis. Timestamps sensor readings against flight position so imagery and readings can be georeferenced afterwards.

title: Warehouse Environment Compliance Logger
description: Logs temperature and humidity across a warehouse for regulatory compliance with tamper-evident records. Signs each record so a stored history cannot be quietly edited before an audit.

title: Pipeline Pressure Monitoring
description: Monitors pressure along a pipeline and infers leak location from the pressure gradient between sensors. Correlating across sensors is what turns a pressure drop into an actionable location.

title: Smart Mirror with Information Display
description: Builds a mirror that overlays time, weather, calendar and transit information behind a two-way mirror. Manages screen brightness to remain readable without destroying the mirror illusion in a dark room.

title: Automated Pet Feeder with Portion Control
description: Dispenses measured pet food on schedule with a weight sensor confirming the portion actually delivered. Confirming delivery matters because a jammed dispenser otherwise reports a fed pet that has not eaten.

title: Robotic Arm Pick and Place with Vision
description: Picks objects identified by a camera and places them at target locations using inverse kinematics. Hand-eye calibration between camera and arm frames is the step that determines whether the grasp succeeds at all.

title: Autonomous Delivery Robot for Campus
description: Navigates a campus to deliver small parcels, avoiding pedestrians and obeying pathway constraints. Treats pedestrian behaviour as unpredictable and plans conservatively, since a confident robot near people is a hazard.

title: Swarm Robotics Formation Control
description: Coordinates a group of robots into formations using only local sensing and neighbour communication. Uses distributed consensus so the formation survives losing any individual robot, unlike a central controller.

title: Self-Balancing Two-Wheeled Robot
description: Balances an inverted-pendulum robot using a PID controller over fused gyroscope and accelerometer data. Complementary filtering of the two sensors is what makes the angle estimate stable enough to control.

title: Maze Solving Micromouse Robot
description: Explores an unknown maze, maps it, then runs the shortest discovered route at speed. Separates exploration from the speed run, which is exactly how competitive micromouse robots are structured.

title: Agricultural Weeding Robot
description: Drives between crop rows identifying and mechanically removing weeds without herbicide. Must distinguish seedling crops from weeds reliably, since a false positive destroys the plant it was protecting.

title: Pipe Inspection Crawler Robot
description: Crawls through pipes streaming video and logging defects against distance travelled. Measures distance by wheel odometry with slip correction, since position is meaningless without it inside a featureless pipe.

title: Underwater Remotely Operated Vehicle
description: Controls a tethered underwater vehicle with depth hold, heading control and live camera feed. Depth and attitude holding free the operator to concentrate on the task rather than constantly fighting buoyancy.

title: Autonomous Lawn Mower with Boundary Mapping
description: Mows a lawn autonomously within a mapped boundary using systematic coverage rather than random walk. Includes lift and tilt cutouts, because an exposed spinning blade demands hardware-level safety.

title: Robotic Vacuum with Coverage Planning
description: Plans efficient room coverage with obstacle avoidance and resumes correctly after recharging. Compares systematic coverage against random bounce to quantify how much time the planning actually saves.

title: Gesture-Controlled Robotic Arm
description: Controls a robotic arm by mirroring hand movements tracked from a camera. Smooths and rate-limits the mapping, since raw hand tracking noise translates into violent servo movement.

title: Voice-Controlled Mobile Robot
description: Drives a mobile robot from spoken commands with confirmation for movement instructions. Requires explicit stop recognition to be the most reliable command, since it is the one that matters under failure.

title: SLAM Mapping Robot with LiDAR
description: Builds a map of an unknown indoor space while localising within it using LiDAR scans. Loop closure is what stops accumulated drift from folding the map onto itself after a full circuit.

title: Object Sorting Robot by Colour and Shape
description: Sorts items on a conveyor into bins by colour and shape using a camera and diverter arm. Timing the actuator against belt speed is the real engineering problem, not the classification.

title: Humanoid Robot Balance Control
description: Keeps a simulated humanoid upright under disturbance using centre-of-pressure feedback. Works in simulation first, where a fall costs a reset rather than a broken actuator.

title: Drone Obstacle Avoidance System
description: Avoids obstacles in flight using stereo depth and reactive path adjustment. Reacts within the drone's stopping distance, which sets a hard upper bound on safe flight speed.

title: Drone Landing on Moving Platform
description: Lands a drone on a moving target using visual marker tracking and predictive control. Predicts platform motion rather than chasing it, since pure feedback always lags a moving target.

title: Robotic Fish for Water Quality Sampling
description: Swims through water bodies collecting quality measurements with minimal disturbance to aquatic life. Undulating propulsion avoids the sediment disturbance that propellers cause and that corrupts the samples.

title: Assistive Feeding Robot Arm
description: Assists users with limited arm mobility to eat, guiding food from plate to mouth on request. Force limiting and predictable slow motion matter far more than speed when the end effector approaches a face.

title: Warehouse AGV Fleet Coordination
description: Coordinates automated guided vehicles sharing aisles, preventing deadlock at intersections. Deadlock avoidance rather than detection is essential, since recovering a jammed warehouse floor requires human intervention.

title: Robot Soccer Strategy Simulation
description: Simulates a robot soccer team with role assignment, passing and positioning strategies. Evaluates strategies over many matches, since single-game outcomes in a low-scoring game are mostly noise.

title: Teleoperated Surgical Arm Simulator
description: Simulates a teleoperated surgical instrument with motion scaling and tremor filtering. Scaling operator movement down is what converts ordinary hand precision into surgical precision.

title: Cable-Driven Parallel Robot Control
description: Positions a platform suspended by motorised cables, solving for tensions that keep every cable taut. Cables can pull but never push, which makes the tension distribution problem fundamentally different from rigid linkages.

title: Exoskeleton Gait Assistance Controller
description: Detects gait phase from joint and pressure sensors and applies assistive torque at the right moment. Assistance timed even slightly wrong actively fights the wearer rather than helping them.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Robot Grasping
description: Learns grasping policies in simulation and examines what transfers to a physical arm. Randomises simulation physics during training, which is the main technique that narrows the reality gap.

title: AR Furniture Placement in Rooms
description: Places true-to-scale furniture models in a live camera view of a room with correct occlusion. Real-world scale accuracy is the whole value, since a sofa that looks right but does not fit is worse than no preview.

title: AR Anatomy Learning for Medical Students
description: Displays interactive anatomical models that students can rotate, dissect layer by layer and label. Layer isolation is what makes structures learnable, since a complete model is visually impenetrable.

title: AR Museum Exhibit Information Overlay
description: Recognises museum exhibits through the camera and overlays contextual information and narration. Recognises artefacts by image rather than markers, since visible QR codes beside exhibits are unacceptable to curators.

title: AR Navigation Arrows for Indoor Wayfinding
description: Overlays directional arrows on the camera view to guide users through large indoor spaces. Corrects positional drift against recognised visual landmarks, since inertial tracking alone diverges within a corridor.

title: AR Business Card with 3D Profile
description: Turns a printed business card into a trigger for a 3D animated profile with contact links. A compact first AR project where marker tracking is reliable and the whole scope stays achievable.

title: AR Manual Overlay for Machine Repair
description: Overlays step-by-step repair instructions onto the actual machine being serviced. Anchors each instruction to the specific component, which removes the translation step from diagram to real hardware.

title: AR Measurement Tool for Rooms
description: Measures distances, areas and volumes in a room by tapping points in the camera view. Reports an accuracy estimate alongside each measurement, since AR measurement error grows with distance and users assume precision.

title: AR Plant Identification with Care Overlay
description: Identifies plants through the camera and overlays care instructions and watering schedules. Runs classification on-device, since gardens and nurseries frequently have no usable mobile signal.

title: VR Fire Safety Evacuation Training
description: Trains building occupants to evacuate safely through realistic smoke and alarm scenarios. Scores decisions rather than completion time, since the correct behaviour is often to move deliberately rather than fastest.

title: VR Public Speaking Practice Environment
description: Lets users rehearse presentations before a simulated audience with configurable size and reactions. Analyses pace, filler words and pauses to give specific feedback rather than a general confidence score.

title: VR Machine Operation Training Simulator
description: Trains operators on dangerous machinery in VR before they touch the real equipment. Simulates unsafe outcomes explicitly, because training that never shows the consequence teaches procedure without teaching why.

title: VR Architectural Walkthrough
description: Lets clients walk through a building design at true scale before construction begins. Optimises imported architectural models heavily, since CAD geometry is far too dense for comfortable VR frame rates.

title: VR Physics Experiment Sandbox
description: Provides a VR laboratory for physics experiments with adjustable gravity, friction and mass. Includes measurement instruments, so the sandbox supports actual experiments rather than only play.

title: VR Exposure Therapy for Phobias
description: Delivers graded exposure therapy for common phobias under therapist control of intensity. Requires an immediate exit at all times and is designed for clinical supervision rather than solo use.

title: VR Historical Site Reconstruction
description: Reconstructs a historical site as it stood, letting users explore and compare with the present ruins. Marks reconstructed detail as evidenced or conjectural, so the experience does not present speculation as fact.

title: VR Driving Hazard Perception Trainer
description: Trains hazard perception by presenting developing road situations and measuring reaction timing. Measures when the hazard was first noticed rather than only whether a crash occurred.

title: VR Surgical Procedure Rehearsal
description: Lets surgeons rehearse a procedure step sequence with instrument handling and anatomical variation. Scores procedural order and error recovery, which are what rehearsal genuinely improves.

title: AR Sports Training Feedback Overlay
description: Overlays technique feedback on a live view of an athlete, comparing joint angles against a reference form. Gives one correction at a time, since athletes cannot act on five simultaneous instructions mid-movement.

title: VR Collaborative Design Review Room
description: Brings remote participants into a shared VR space to review 3D models with pointing and annotation. Synchronises annotations and viewpoints reliably, since a review where participants see different states is worthless.

title: AR Assembly Guidance for Electronics
description: Guides through circuit assembly by highlighting the next component and its placement on the board. Verifies each completed step visually before advancing, catching errors while they are still cheap to fix.

title: NFT Marketplace with Royalty Enforcement
description: Mints and trades non-fungible tokens with creator royalties enforced in the contract rather than by marketplace policy. Stores media on distributed storage, since an on-chain token pointing at a dead URL owns nothing.

title: Decentralised Crowdfunding with Refund Guarantees
description: Runs funding campaigns where contributions are automatically refundable if the goal is not met by the deadline. The refund path is the contract's most important behaviour and gets the heaviest test coverage.

title: Land Registry on Blockchain
description: Records property ownership and transfer history immutably with authorised registrar roles. Addresses the oracle problem directly, since the chain cannot verify that an off-chain deed was genuinely signed.

title: Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Anti-Counterfeiting
description: Tracks medicine batches from manufacture to pharmacy so patients can verify authenticity by scanning a code. Detects duplicate scans of the same unit, which is the signature of a copied authentication code.

title: Decentralised File Storage with Incentives
description: Stores files across a peer network with payments to nodes that demonstrably retain the data. Requires periodic proof of possession, without which nodes can collect payment while storing nothing.

title: Token-Gated Content Platform
description: Grants access to content based on ownership of a token, verified by wallet signature. Verifies ownership server-side at request time, since client-side checks are trivially bypassed.

title: Decentralised Autonomous Organisation Voting
description: Implements proposal creation, token-weighted voting and timelocked execution for a member organisation. Includes a timelock between passing and execution, giving members time to exit before a hostile proposal takes effect.

title: Carbon Credit Trading Platform
description: Issues, trades and permanently retires carbon credits with an auditable trail. Retirement must be irreversible and visible, since double-counting is the central failure of voluntary carbon markets.

title: Blockchain-Based Medical Record Consent
description: Records patient consent for data access on-chain while keeping the records themselves encrypted off-chain. Puts only consent grants and revocations on the immutable ledger, never the health data itself.

title: Peer-to-Peer Energy Trading
description: Lets households with solar generation sell surplus power to neighbours with automated settlement. Integrates meter readings as the trusted input, which is where the trust actually has to be established.

title: Escrow Smart Contract for Freelancers
description: Holds client funds in a contract released on milestone approval, with arbitration for disputes. Bounds the arbitrator's power so a malicious arbiter cannot simply take the funds.

title: Decentralised Identity Wallet
description: Holds verifiable credentials that users present selectively without revealing unrelated attributes. Supports proving age without disclosing date of birth, which is the point of selective disclosure.

title: Blockchain Lottery with Verifiable Randomness
description: Runs a provably fair lottery using an external verifiable randomness source rather than block data. Block-derived randomness is manipulable by miners, which is exactly the attack this design exists to prevent.

title: Charity Fund Transparency Tracker
description: Tracks donations from receipt through to disbursement so donors can follow where money went. Records spending categories on-chain, turning a transparency claim into something independently checkable.

title: Music Royalty Distribution Contract
description: Splits streaming revenue automatically among rights holders according to agreed shares. Handles fractional remainders explicitly, since integer arithmetic otherwise silently loses value on every distribution.

title: Insurance Payout Automation with Oracles
description: Pays crop or flight-delay insurance automatically when an external data feed confirms the trigger condition. Uses multiple independent oracles, because a single data source becomes a single point of manipulation.

title: Ticket Resale Control with Smart Contracts
description: Issues event tickets as tokens whose resale price is capped by the contract to limit scalping. Enforces the cap at transfer time, so the restriction cannot be bypassed by an off-platform sale.

title: Decentralised Exchange with Liquidity Pool
description: Implements a constant-product automated market maker with liquidity provision and swap fees. Demonstrates impermanent loss concretely, which most liquidity providers discover only after suffering it.

title: Stablecoin Mechanism Simulation
description: Simulates collateralised stablecoin mechanics under price shocks to observe when the peg breaks. Stress tests the liquidation cascade, which is how most algorithmic stablecoins have historically failed.

title: On-Chain Voting for Student Union
description: Runs student elections with verifiable tallies while keeping individual votes private. Separates eligibility from identity, so the roll proves a voter may vote without revealing how they voted.

title: Warranty Registration on Blockchain
description: Registers product warranties as transferable records so cover survives a resale of the item. Solves the lost-receipt problem, which is the ordinary reason warranty claims get rejected.

title: Agricultural Produce Traceability
description: Traces produce from farm through processing to retail with each handover recorded by the responsible party. Attributes each record to a specific participant, which makes contamination tracing possible in hours rather than weeks.

title: Cross-Border Remittance Prototype
description: Demonstrates low-cost cross-border transfers with on-chain settlement and local currency conversion at each end. The last-mile conversion to cash is the genuinely hard part and is addressed explicitly rather than assumed away.

title: Smart Contract Vulnerability Scanner
description: Analyses Solidity source for reentrancy, integer issues, unchecked calls and access control mistakes. Reports severity with the exact code path, since an unranked list of two hundred warnings gets ignored.

title: Blockchain Explorer for a Test Network
description: Indexes blocks, transactions and addresses from a test network into a searchable web explorer. Handles chain reorganisations, which silently corrupt any indexer that assumes blocks are final on arrival.

title: Multi-Signature Wallet Implementation
description: Implements a wallet requiring several approvals before a transaction executes, with owner management. Guards the owner-change path most carefully, since that is where a multisig can be quietly taken over.

title: Proof of Attendance Token System
description: Issues non-transferable tokens proving attendance at an event, claimed by scanning a code on site. Time-bounds and location-bounds claiming, since an unrestricted claim link spreads instantly and proves nothing.

title: Web Application Vulnerability Scanner
description: Crawls an authorised web application and tests for common injection, configuration and access flaws. Requires explicit scope configuration before running, since scanning systems you do not own is unlawful.

title: Port Scanner and Service Fingerprinting Tool
description: Scans authorised hosts for open ports and identifies the services and versions behind them. Rate-limits probing to avoid disrupting the services being assessed, which is a basic engagement courtesy.

title: Log Analysis for Intrusion Indicators
description: Parses server and authentication logs to surface indicators such as credential stuffing and privilege escalation. Correlates across log sources, since individually unremarkable events are what compose an actual intrusion.

title: Ransomware Behaviour Detection
description: Detects ransomware by its behaviour, such as rapid mass file rewrites and shadow copy deletion, rather than signatures. Behavioural detection is what catches variants that no signature database has seen.

title: Malware Classification from Static Features
description: Classifies malware families from static binary features without executing the sample. Works entirely on inert features, which is what makes the analysis safe to run outside a sandbox.

title: DNS Tunnelling Detection
description: Detects data exfiltration hidden in DNS queries using entropy, query length and frequency features. DNS is often the one protocol allowed out unchecked, which is exactly why it gets abused this way.

title: Brute Force Login Detection and Lockout
description: Detects repeated failed authentication attempts and applies progressive delays and lockouts. Rate-limits per account and per source separately, since attacking one account and spraying many look different.

title: Security Headers Audit Tool
description: Audits a site's security headers and content security policy, explaining the risk each missing header leaves open. Suggests a concrete policy rather than only reporting absence, which is what makes the finding actionable.

title: SQL Injection Detection in Query Logs
description: Detects likely injection attempts in database query logs by structural anomaly rather than keyword matching. Keyword rules miss obfuscated payloads and flood on legitimate queries containing SQL words.

title: Cross-Site Scripting Payload Detector
description: Detects cross-site scripting payloads in submitted input and evaluates whether sanitisation neutralises them. Tests the sanitiser against encoding variants, which is where most home-grown filters fail.

title: Secure Code Review Assistant for Common Flaws
description: Reviews code changes for hardcoded secrets, unsafe deserialisation, injection and weak cryptography. Reports only on changed lines with a suggested fix, since noisy security tools get disabled within a week.

title: Two-Factor Authentication Service
description: Implements time-based one-time password authentication with enrolment, verification and recovery codes. Gets the recovery flow right, because that path is how most two-factor implementations are actually bypassed.

title: Encrypted Chat with Forward Secrecy
description: Implements end-to-end encrypted messaging with per-message key ratcheting. Forward secrecy means a compromised key today cannot decrypt yesterday's messages, which is the entire design goal.

title: File Integrity Monitoring System
description: Monitors critical files for unauthorised modification by comparing cryptographic hashes against a baseline. Protects the baseline itself, since an attacker who can edit the baseline defeats the whole system.

title: Honeypot for Attack Pattern Collection
description: Runs an isolated decoy service that records attacker behaviour for defensive research. Isolation is the critical control, because a compromised honeypot that reaches the real network is a self-inflicted breach.

title: Network Traffic Anomaly Dashboard
description: Baselines normal network traffic and visualises deviations in volume, destinations and protocols. Baselines per time of day, since night-time traffic that would be normal at noon is genuinely suspicious.

title: Certificate Expiry Monitoring Service
description: Monitors TLS certificates across a domain inventory and warns before expiry with escalating urgency. Checks the full chain, since an expired intermediate breaks the site exactly like an expired leaf.

title: Privileged Access Audit Tool
description: Audits which accounts hold elevated permissions and flags dormant or excessive privilege. Highlights accounts whose privileges exceed their actual usage, which is where least privilege quietly erodes.

title: Data Loss Prevention Content Scanner
description: Scans outbound content for identifiers, card numbers and confidential markers before transmission. Validates candidate matches with checksums, which removes the false positives that make naive pattern rules unusable.

title: Insider Threat Behaviour Analytics
description: Baselines normal employee system behaviour and flags deviations such as unusual bulk downloads. Designed with explicit privacy limits, since indiscriminate employee monitoring is both unlawful in many places and corrosive.

title: Wi-Fi Network Security Auditor
description: Audits authorised wireless networks for weak encryption, default credentials and rogue access points. Requires written scope confirmation before scanning, since wireless assessment easily reaches neighbouring networks.

title: Secure Password Reset Flow Implementation
description: Implements password reset with single-use time-limited tokens and no account enumeration. Returns an identical response whether or not the address exists, which is what prevents enumeration.

title: API Rate Limiting and Abuse Detection
description: Applies tiered rate limits and detects abuse patterns such as credential stuffing and scraping. Uses a sliding window rather than fixed buckets, which otherwise permit double the limit at a boundary.

title: Container Image Vulnerability Scanner
description: Scans container images for known vulnerable packages and ranks findings by exploitability in context. Distinguishes vulnerable-and-reachable from merely present, which is most of the noise in image scanning.

title: Security Awareness Phishing Simulator
description: Runs authorised internal phishing simulations and delivers training to those who click. Designed to teach rather than punish, since blame-based simulations reduce the reporting the programme depends on.

title: Dark Web Credential Exposure Monitor
description: Checks whether organisational credentials appear in known breach corpora and alerts affected users. Matches on hashed values only, so the tool never stores or transmits plaintext passwords itself.

title: Steganography Detection in Images
description: Detects data hidden inside images using statistical irregularities in pixel and coefficient distributions. Reports likelihood rather than certainty, since clean-looking carriers and noisy originals both exist.

title: Digital Forensics Timeline Builder
description: Builds a unified chronological timeline from file system, log and browser artefacts for investigation. Preserves original timestamps with timezone handling, since a timeline off by hours misattributes causality.

title: Zero Trust Access Policy Evaluator
description: Evaluates access requests against contextual policy covering identity, device posture and location. Logs the reasoning behind each decision, because an unexplainable denial is impossible to support or debug.

title: Supply Chain Dependency Risk Analyser
description: Analyses project dependencies for known advisories, unmaintained packages and suspicious ownership changes. Flags maintainer changes on widely-depended packages, which is the pattern behind recent supply chain attacks.

title: Infrastructure as Code for Multi-Environment Deploys
description: Defines development, staging and production infrastructure from one parameterised codebase. Keeps state isolated per environment, since shared state is how a staging change destroys production.

title: Kubernetes Autoscaling Demonstrator
description: Demonstrates horizontal pod autoscaling under generated load with metrics showing scale-up latency. Measures the lag between load arriving and capacity appearing, which is what determines user-visible impact.

title: Centralised Logging Pipeline
description: Collects logs from distributed services into a searchable central store with structured fields. Enforces retention and index lifecycle, without which log storage grows until it becomes the largest infrastructure cost.

title: Metrics and Alerting Stack
description: Instruments services with metrics and defines alerts that page only on user-visible symptoms. Alerts on symptoms rather than causes, which is what keeps the on-call pager meaningful.

title: Blue-Green Deployment Pipeline
description: Deploys a new version alongside the old and switches traffic atomically once health checks pass. Keeps the previous version warm, making rollback a traffic switch rather than a redeploy.

title: Canary Release with Automated Rollback
description: Routes a small traffic share to a new version and promotes or rolls back automatically on error metrics. Defines rollback thresholds before release, since deciding during an incident produces the wrong call.

title: Container Registry with Image Signing
description: Runs a private container registry that signs images at build and verifies signatures at deploy. Rejecting unsigned images at admission is what makes the signature more than decoration.

title: Secrets Management Integration
description: Removes credentials from code and configuration by injecting them at runtime from a managed store. Implements rotation from the outset, because retrofitting rotation onto hardcoded secrets is far harder.

title: Database Backup and Restore Automation
description: Automates scheduled backups with retention tiers and, critically, regularly tests restoring them. An untested backup is a hypothesis, and this project treats restore drills as the actual deliverable.

title: Cost Monitoring and Optimisation Dashboard
description: Attributes cloud spend to teams and services through tagging and highlights idle or oversized resources. Attribution is the precondition for optimisation, since untagged spend belongs to nobody and gets cut by nobody.

title: Service Mesh Traffic Management Demo
description: Demonstrates retries, timeouts, circuit breaking and traffic splitting between service versions. Shows how careless retry configuration amplifies an overload into a cascading failure.

title: Chaos Engineering Fault Injection Harness
description: Injects controlled failures such as pod kills and network latency to test system resilience. Defines the hypothesis and abort conditions first, which is the difference between chaos engineering and simply breaking things.

title: GitOps Continuous Deployment Workflow
description: Makes a Git repository the single source of truth for cluster state with automatic reconciliation. Detects and reports drift when someone changes the cluster directly, which is the habit GitOps exists to end.

title: Multi-Region Failover Architecture
description: Designs and tests automatic failover between regions including data replication and traffic redirection. Tests failover regularly, since an untested failover path usually fails at the moment it is first needed.

title: Serverless REST API with Auto-Scaling
description: Builds a REST API on managed functions that scales to zero and handles bursts without provisioning. Addresses cold starts and connection pooling, which are the two problems that surprise every first serverless API.

title: Message Queue Based Task Processing
description: Processes background work through a durable queue with retries and dead letter handling. Makes consumers idempotent, because at-least-once delivery guarantees some messages arrive twice.

title: Data Pipeline Orchestration with Airflow
description: Orchestrates dependent data processing tasks with scheduling, retries and backfill support. Makes tasks idempotent so a backfill can safely rerun without duplicating yesterday's output.

title: ML Model Serving with Versioning
description: Serves machine learning models behind a versioned API with staged rollout and rollback. Monitors prediction distribution drift, since a model degrades silently while the service reports perfect health.

title: Experiment Tracking for ML Projects
description: Tracks model experiments with parameters, metrics, code version and data version together. Versioning data alongside code is what makes a result actually reproducible months later.

title: Load Testing Harness with Reporting
description: Generates realistic load profiles against a service and reports latency percentiles and error rates under each. Reports tail latency rather than averages, since the slowest requests are what users actually notice.

title: Static Site Deployment with CDN Invalidation
description: Deploys a static site to a content delivery network with automated cache invalidation on release. Invalidates selectively rather than purging everything, which otherwise causes an origin traffic spike on every deploy.

title: Ephemeral Preview Environments per Pull Request
description: Spins up a complete disposable environment for every pull request and destroys it on merge. Guarantees teardown even when a pipeline fails, since orphaned environments are how preview systems become expensive.

title: Compliance Policy as Code Enforcement
description: Encodes compliance rules as machine-checked policies enforced at deployment admission. Blocks violations before deployment rather than reporting them afterwards, which is what turns audit into prevention.

title: Log Retention and Archival Automation
description: Moves logs through hot, warm and archival storage tiers automatically according to retention policy. Balances the legal minimum retention against storage cost, which are usually in direct tension.

title: Self-Hosted Runner Autoscaling
description: Scales continuous integration runners on demand and scales them back to zero when the queue empties. Isolates each job in a fresh runner, since reusing runners across untrusted jobs leaks secrets between builds.

title: Nurse Shift Roster Optimiser with Fairness Constraints
description: Builds weekly nurse rosters that satisfy minimum cover, rest-period and skill-mix rules, then scores each solution on how evenly night shifts and weekend duty are shared so no one is quietly overloaded.

title: Loan Eligibility Rule Engine with Forward Chaining
description: Encodes a bank's published eligibility rules as an explicit rule base and chains through them so an applicant sees exactly which rule fired and which missing fact would change the outcome.

title: Bayesian Network Car Fault Diagnosis Advisor
description: Models the causal links between symptoms, such as a rough idle or a warning light, and underlying faults, then updates fault probabilities as the owner answers follow-up questions about the car.

title: Monte Carlo Tree Search Player for Othello
description: Implements an Othello engine that uses Monte Carlo tree search with tuned rollout policies, and measures how win rate against a minimax baseline changes with the simulation budget per move.

title: Automated Negotiation Agent for Bargaining Simulations
description: Builds software agents that negotiate over multi-issue offers with hidden preferences, comparing concession strategies and opponent-modelling tactics across thousands of simulated bargaining rounds.

title: Fuzzy Logic Greenhouse Irrigation Advisor
description: Replaces hard on-off watering thresholds with fuzzy rules over temperature, humidity and soil dryness so the advised watering duration changes smoothly instead of jumping at cut-off values.

title: Shipping Container Loading Planner with 3D Bin Packing
description: Plans how mixed-size cartons fit into a container while respecting weight balance and unloading order, comparing greedy placement with a metaheuristic and reporting volume utilisation.

title: Multi-Armed Bandit Recommender for Cold-Start Content
description: Chooses which new article or video to show when there is no click history yet, balancing exploration and exploitation with bandit algorithms and replaying logged traffic to estimate regret offline.

title: Household Task Planner Using PDDL
description: Describes a home environment and chores in PDDL and uses an automated planner to sequence actions such as fetching, washing and storing, then explains why a goal is unreachable when constraints conflict.

title: Counterfactual Explanation Generator for Tabular Models
description: Given a rejected prediction, searches for the smallest realistic change to the inputs that would flip the decision, constraining edits to features a person could actually alter.

title: Active Learning Annotation Assistant
description: Reduces labelling effort by repeatedly asking a human to label only the examples a model is most uncertain about, and plots accuracy against labels spent for several query strategies.

title: Case-Based Reasoning Helpdesk Assistant
description: Retrieves the most similar solved support cases for a new IT problem, adapts the earlier fix to the new context and stores confirmed outcomes so the case library improves over time.

title: Knowledge Tracing for Programming Exercises
description: Estimates what a student has mastered from their sequence of exercise attempts and recommends the next problem, comparing Bayesian knowledge tracing with a sequence model on held-out students.

title: Chord Progression Harmoniser from a Melody
description: Suggests chords for a short melody using music-theory rules about key, cadences and voice leading, and lets the user compare rule-based output with a simple probabilistic model.

title: Equilibrium Strategy for Kuhn Poker with Counterfactual Regret Minimisation
description: Solves a small poker variant with counterfactual regret minimisation, shows the strategy converging towards equilibrium, and tests it against exploitative opponents.

title: Agent-Based Evacuation Simulation of a Campus Building
description: Simulates how people leave a building during an alarm, with crowd congestion at doors and stairwells, and tests how exit signage or an extra door changes total evacuation time.

title: Prerequisite Graph Analyser for Degree Programmes
description: Reads a course catalogue into a directed graph, detects circular prerequisites, finds the longest dependency chain and highlights courses that block the most downstream options.

title: Sokoban Solver with Deadlock Detection
description: Solves box-pushing puzzles with heuristic search, adds deadlock detection to prune hopeless states early, and reports how much pruning reduces the number of states explored.

title: Two-by-Two Cube Solver with IDA-star
description: Solves the pocket cube optimally using iterative-deepening A-star with a pattern-database heuristic, and compares memory use and solve time with plain breadth-first search.

title: Argumentation Framework Solver for Debate Maps
description: Represents arguments and the attacks between them as a graph and computes which sets of arguments can be defended together under several formal semantics, visualising the result.

title: Ambulance Station Placement with Facility Location Optimisation
description: Chooses where to place a limited number of ambulance stations so that the worst-case response time across a city grid is as low as possible, comparing exact and heuristic solvers.

title: Text Adventure Engine with Finite State Dialogue
description: Builds a small adventure game where rooms, items and non-player dialogue are defined in data files and driven by a finite state machine, so a new story needs no code changes.

title: Hangman Solver Using Letter Frequencies and Language Models
description: Plays hangman by choosing the most informative next letter from a word list, then compares plain frequency counting with a model that conditions on the letters already revealed.

title: Interactive Decision Tree Teaching Tool
description: Lets learners build a decision tree one split at a time on a small dataset, shows entropy and information gain at every choice, and compares their tree with the algorithm's.

title: Q-Learning Controller for a Multi-Lift Building
description: Trains lift controllers with reinforcement learning to reduce average passenger waiting time in a simulated building, and compares the learned policy with a nearest-car rule under rush-hour traffic.

title: Self-Play Agent for Dots and Boxes
description: Trains an agent to play dots and boxes through self-play and shows how its handling of chains and sacrifices improves compared with a greedy opponent.

title: Event Seating Planner with Social Constraints
description: Assigns guests to tables so that listed pairs sit together and conflicting pairs are kept apart, using a constraint solver and showing which wishes had to be compromised.

title: Genetic Algorithm Exam Invigilation Duty Allocator
description: Allocates invigilation duties to staff across exam sessions while respecting availability, workload caps and room rules, evolving schedules with a genetic algorithm and reporting constraint violations.

title: Subscriber Survival Analysis for Time-to-Cancellation
description: Models how long subscribers stay rather than only whether they leave, using Kaplan-Meier curves and a Cox model, and shows which plan features lengthen or shorten the expected lifetime.

title: Uplift Modelling for Discount Targeting
description: Estimates which customers are actually persuaded by a discount, rather than those who would buy anyway, by modelling the difference in outcome between treated and untreated groups.

title: Propensity Score Matching for Evaluating a Tutoring Programme
description: Estimates the effect of an optional tutoring scheme on exam results from observational records by matching similar students and checking covariate balance before and after matching.

title: Probability Calibration Toolkit for Classifiers
description: Checks whether predicted probabilities can be trusted by drawing reliability curves, then fixes miscalibrated models with Platt scaling and isotonic regression and reports the change in Brier score.

title: Imbalanced Learning Benchmark on Rare-Event Datasets
description: Compares resampling, class weighting and threshold moving on datasets where the positive class is under one percent, and reports precision-recall behaviour rather than accuracy.

title: Learning to Rank Search Results from Click Logs
description: Trains a ranking model from simulated click data, corrects for position bias in the clicks, and evaluates the ordering with normalised discounted cumulative gain.

title: Bus Arrival Time Prediction from Historical GPS Traces
description: Predicts when a bus will reach each remaining stop using past trips, time of day and the delay already accumulated on the current route, and reports error by distance to the stop.

title: Perishable Stock Spoilage Predictor for Grocers
description: Predicts how many units of fresh produce will spoil before sale from delivery date, storage temperature and sales rate, so ordering can be trimmed without causing stock-outs.

title: Conformal Prediction Intervals for Delivery Time Estimates
description: Wraps any regression model with conformal prediction so each delivery estimate comes with an interval that provably covers the true time at a chosen rate, and checks coverage by customer segment.

title: Model Drift Monitor for a Deployed Classifier
description: Detects when live input data no longer resembles training data using population stability and statistical tests, and raises an alert before accuracy visibly degrades.

title: Bayesian Hyperparameter Optimisation Workbench
description: Compares random search, grid search and Bayesian optimisation on the same models and budgets, and plots how quickly each finds good settings.

title: Quantile Regression for Energy Price Risk Bands
description: Predicts the range a day-ahead electricity price is likely to fall in rather than one number, using quantile regression and evaluating the bands with pinball loss.

title: Mobility Pattern Clustering from Anonymised Trip Records
description: Groups commuters by when and where they travel using clustering on trip features, and describes each group in terms a transport planner can act on.

title: Multi-Label Tagging of Support Articles
description: Assigns several topic tags to each help-centre article at once with a multi-label classifier, and shows per-tag precision so weak tags can be reviewed by a person.

title: Semi-Supervised Image Feature Classifier with Few Labels
description: Trains a classifier when only a tenth of the data is labelled by propagating labels through feature similarity, and charts accuracy against the number of true labels used.

title: Spare Part Demand Forecasting with Intermittent Series
description: Forecasts demand for parts that sell in sporadic bursts using methods built for intermittent data, and shows why ordinary error metrics mislead on such series.

title: Feature Store Prototype for Reusable Model Inputs
description: Builds a small feature store that computes features once, serves them consistently to training and prediction code, and prevents leakage from future data with point-in-time joins.

title: Interpretable Credit Limit Scorecard with Monotonic Constraints
description: Builds a scorecard where each variable moves the score in a sensible direction, using monotonic constraints and weight of evidence, and documents every reason code.

title: Course Grade Prediction with Prerequisite Performance
description: Predicts a student's grade in a course from their results in prerequisite courses, and shows which earlier subjects are the strongest predictors.

title: Matching Engine for Peer Study Groups
description: Forms study groups by clustering students on course load, availability windows and learning preferences, and checks that groups are balanced in size and schedule overlap.

title: Online Learning Fraud Detector for Streaming Transactions
description: Updates a fraud model one transaction at a time without retraining from scratch, and compares its adaptation to changing fraud patterns with a periodically retrained batch model.

title: Patient No-Show Predictor for Clinic Scheduling
description: Estimates which appointments are likely to be missed so a clinic can plan overbooking and reminder calls, and audits the model for unequal error rates across age groups.

title: Ensemble Stacking Playground for Tabular Data
description: Lets a learner combine several base models through stacking and blending, and measures when the combination beats the best single model and when it only adds complexity.

title: Outlier Detection Comparison on Sensor Readings
description: Applies several outlier detectors to the same sensor dataset with known injected faults and compares how many faults each finds and how many normal readings it wrongly flags.

title: Learning Curve Explorer for Model Selection
description: Plots training and validation scores against dataset size and model complexity so a beginner can see whether a model needs more data, more capacity or less of both.

title: Cricket Run-Rate Projection from Ball-by-Ball Data
description: Projects the final score of an innings from the match state so far, accounting for wickets in hand and overs left, and measures how projection error shrinks as the innings progresses.

title: Knowledge Distillation into a Mobile-Sized Image Classifier
description: Trains a small student network to imitate a large teacher by matching softened outputs, and reports accuracy, model size and inference time for students with and without distillation.

title: Contrastive Learning of Image Embeddings without Labels
description: Learns useful image representations from unlabelled pictures using contrastive loss on augmented views, then tests them with a linear classifier trained on very few labels.

title: Variational Autoencoder for Exploring a Font Latent Space
description: Trains a variational autoencoder on font glyphs and lets users move through the latent space to blend styles, while checking how smooth and meaningful the interpolations are.

title: GAN for Synthetic Tabular Data with Privacy Evaluation
description: Generates synthetic customer-style records with a conditional GAN and evaluates both how useful they are for training and how easily real rows can be re-identified from them.

title: Prototypical Networks for Few-Shot Image Classification
description: Classifies new categories from five examples each by comparing images with learned class prototypes, and studies how accuracy changes with the number of shots and ways.

title: Transformer Encoder for Multivariate Sensor Forecasting
description: Forecasts several correlated sensor channels with a transformer encoder and compares it with LSTM and linear baselines, including how each handles long input windows.

title: Keyword Spotting for Tiny Devices
description: Trains a compact network to recognise a handful of spoken commands from audio spectrograms and measures how small it can be made before accuracy on noisy clips falls.

title: Neural Network from Scratch with a Backpropagation Visualiser
description: Implements a small feed-forward network using only NumPy and animates how gradients flow backwards through each layer on a toy problem, so each update can be traced by hand.

title: Optimiser and Learning Rate Schedule Comparison Lab
description: Trains the same small network with different optimisers and learning rate schedules and plots loss curves side by side, so the effect of each choice is visible rather than assumed.

title: Adversarial Robustness Testing for Image Classifiers
description: Crafts small perturbations that fool a trained classifier, measures how accuracy falls with perturbation size, and tests whether adversarial training restores robustness.

title: Grad-CAM Explanations for CNN Predictions
description: Highlights the image regions a convolutional network relied on for a prediction using Grad-CAM, and checks whether the highlights move when the model is trained on a biased dataset.

title: Siamese Network for Few-Shot Character Recognition
description: Learns whether two handwritten characters belong to the same alphabet symbol and uses that similarity to recognise symbols seen only once during training.

title: Sequence-to-Sequence Date and Number Format Normaliser
description: Trains a small encoder-decoder to convert dates and numbers written in many human formats into one standard form, and inspects which input styles it still gets wrong.

title: Graph Neural Network for Citation Network Classification
description: Classifies research papers into topics using both their text features and the citation links between them, and compares a graph network with a model that ignores the links.

title: Autoencoder Recommender for Sparse Rating Matrices
description: Predicts missing ratings by training an autoencoder on partially observed user histories, and compares it with matrix factorisation on held-out entries.

title: Beat and Tempo Tracking from Audio with a Small CNN
description: Detects beat positions in music from spectrogram features using a convolutional network, then estimates tempo and checks it against annotated tracks.

title: Mixed-Precision and Gradient Accumulation Study for Small GPUs
description: Measures how mixed-precision training and gradient accumulation change memory use, speed and final accuracy so a student with a modest GPU can train larger models.

title: Deep Q-Network Agent for Lunar Landing
description: Trains a deep Q-network to land a simulated craft, adding experience replay and a target network, and shows the effect of each ingredient on learning stability.

title: Small Diffusion Model for Handwritten Digit Generation
description: Builds a denoising diffusion model on a small image set, visualises the reverse denoising steps and compares sample quality as the number of sampling steps is reduced.

title: Pretrained Backbone Transfer Learning Benchmark
