description: Fine-tunes several pretrained image backbones on the same small dataset under one training budget and compares accuracy, training time and sensitivity to learning rate.

title: LSTM versus GRU Temperature Forecast Comparison
description: Forecasts next-day temperature from recent history with LSTM and GRU models of matching size and compares accuracy, training speed and behaviour on unusual weeks.

title: Bird Call Classification from Spectrogram Images
description: Identifies bird species from short field recordings by converting audio to spectrograms and training a CNN, with attention to background noise and overlapping calls.

title: Learned Image Compression with an Autoencoder
description: Compresses images with a convolutional autoencoder trained against a rate and distortion trade-off, and compares quality at equal file size with JPEG.

title: Data Augmentation Policy Study for Small Datasets
description: Tests which augmentations help a small-image classifier and which hurt, by training with each one alone and in combination and reporting the accuracy change with its variance.

title: Model Quantisation and Pruning Impact Study
description: Applies post-training quantisation and weight pruning to a trained network and charts the trade-off between size, latency and accuracy on a target device.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network for the Heat Equation
description: Solves a one-dimensional heat conduction problem with a network trained to satisfy the differential equation and boundary conditions, and compares the result with a numerical solver.

title: Code-Mixed Hinglish Sentiment Classifier
description: Classifies sentiment in messages that mix Hindi written in Roman letters with English, handling inconsistent spellings and comparing a character-level model with a word-level one.

title: Contract Deadline and Renewal Date Extractor
description: Finds notice periods, renewal dates and payment deadlines in contract text, normalises relative expressions such as thirty days after signing, and lists them in a calendar view.

title: Commit Message Generator from Code Diffs
description: Generates short imperative commit messages from a code diff with a sequence model, and evaluates them against real commit messages using overlap metrics and a manual quality check.

title: Duplicate Question Detector for a Programming Forum
description: Flags new questions that repeat an existing one by comparing meaning rather than wording, and measures how many true duplicates surface in the top five suggestions.

title: Lecture Transcript Glossary Builder

title: Oracle Price Feed Manipulation Simulation
description: Models how a lending contract can be exploited when it trusts a thin price source, and tests defences such as time-weighted averages and multiple feeds against simulated attacks.

title: Event Indexer for Smart Contract Data
description: Reads contract events from a node, stores them in a relational database and serves queries through an API, handling chain reorganisations without leaving stale rows.

title: Cross-Chain Bridge Concept Simulation
description: Simulates locking assets on one chain and minting wrapped assets on another with relayers and confirmations, and walks through how common bridge failures arise.

title: Prediction Market Contract
description: Lets participants trade shares in the outcome of an event, prices them with an automated market maker and settles from a trusted resolution source with dispute handling.

title: Time-Locked Inheritance Wallet
description: Lets an owner designate beneficiaries who can claim funds only after a long period of inactivity, with a simple check-in action that resets the timer.

title: Streaming Salary Payments Contract
description: Pays an employee continuously by the second from an employer's deposit, supports pausing and cancellation and shows balances updating in real time.

title: Rotating Savings Group Contract
description: Implements a community savings circle where members contribute each round and one member receives the pot in turn, with rules for missed contributions.

title: Bug Bounty Escrow with Staged Payouts
description: Escrows a bounty for a software project, releases staged payments as reports are verified by a reviewer panel and returns unspent funds after the deadline.

title: Gasless Meta-Transaction Relay
description: Lets users interact with a contract without holding native currency by signing messages that a relayer submits, protecting against replayed or forged requests.

title: Wallet with Spending Limits and Social Recovery
description: Builds a smart wallet that caps daily spending and lets trusted guardians help recover access after a lost key, with delays that give the owner time to object.

title: Blockchain Data Structure Visualiser for Teaching
description: Animates how transactions are grouped into blocks and hashed into a chain, lets learners change data and shows exactly which hashes break as a result.

title: Smart Contract Fuzzing and Invariant Testing
description: Writes invariant tests that hold whatever sequence of calls is made to a small lending contract and uses fuzzing to find the inputs that break them.

title: Token Bonding Curve Simulator
description: Simulates tokens priced by a bonding curve, so buying raises the price and selling lowers it, and explores how curve shape affects early buyers and liquidity.

title: Pull-Payment Subscription Contract
description: Lets customers authorise recurring charges up to a limit and period, so a merchant can collect each cycle without the customer signing again and the customer can cancel any time.

title: Hash Time-Locked Contract Atomic Swap Demo
description: Demonstrates swapping assets between two chains without a trusted party using hash and time locks, and shows what happens when either side walks away.

title: Password Hashing Algorithm Comparison Lab
description: Measures how long MD5, SHA-256, bcrypt and Argon2 take on the same machine and uses the numbers to explain why slow, salted hashes protect stored passwords better than fast ones.

title: Secrets Scanner for Git Repositories
description: Scans commit history for accidentally committed keys and tokens using patterns and entropy checks, reports each finding with the commit that introduced it and measures false positives.

title: JSON Web Token Misconfiguration Tester
description: Checks a test API for weak token handling such as accepted none algorithms, missing expiry and signature confusion, and reports each issue with the fix.

title: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing Misconfiguration Checker
description: Probes a site with crafted origins to detect overly permissive cross-origin policies and explains how each risky setting could expose user data.

title: Vulnerable-by-Design Practice App with Guided Fixes
description: Builds a deliberately flawed web app for local use, with exercises that walk learners from exploiting each flaw to patching it and then confirming the fix with tests.

title: TLS Configuration Grader for Servers
description: Connects to a server, inspects protocol versions, cipher suites and certificate chain and produces a graded report that explains each weakness in plain language.

title: Email Authentication Checker for SPF, DKIM and DMARC
description: Looks up a domain's mail authentication records, checks them for common mistakes and explains how a spoofed message would be treated under the published policy.

title: Phishing Email Header Analyser
description: Parses raw email headers to trace the path a message took, compares the sender claims with authentication results and highlights inconsistencies in plain language.

title: Software Bill of Materials Generator and Vulnerability Matcher
description: Lists every dependency of a project in a standard bill-of-materials format and matches versions against a vulnerability database, showing which findings are reachable from the code.

title: Browser Extension Permission Risk Analyser
description: Reads extension manifests, scores the risk of requested permissions and combinations, and explains which permissions would let an extension read data from every site.

title: Android App Permission and Tracker Analysis
description: Examines application packages for requested permissions and embedded third-party tracking libraries, and compares apps in the same category on privacy exposure.

title: Endpoint Hardening Baseline Checker
description: Checks a machine's settings against a published hardening baseline, reports which controls pass or fail and offers safe, reversible fix commands for each failure.

title: Anomalous Login Geovelocity Detector
description: Flags sign-ins that would require impossible travel between locations, while handling VPN use and shared offices to keep false alarms low.

title: Honeytoken Credential Tripwires
description: Plants fake credentials and documents in places an intruder would look and raises an alert the moment one is used, with no impact on real users.

title: Encrypted Backup Tool with Key Rotation
description: Backs up folders with authenticated encryption, supports changing the master key without re-encrypting everything and verifies that restored files match the originals.

title: Shamir Secret Sharing Tool
description: Splits a secret into shares so that any chosen number can rebuild it but fewer reveal nothing, with a clear demonstration of why the threshold property holds.

title: Document and Image Metadata Scrubber
description: Shows what hidden metadata such as author names and GPS coordinates a file carries and removes it before sharing, verifying that the cleaned file no longer contains it.

title: Behavioural Bot Detection from Interaction Signals
description: Distinguishes people from scripts using pointer movement, timing and navigation patterns instead of puzzles, and evaluates how well simple evasion attempts fool it.

title: Process Behaviour Monitor for Suspicious Parent-Child Chains
description: Watches which programs launch which on a test machine and raises alerts on chains that typical office software should never produce, mapped to published attack techniques.

title: Sigma-Style Detection Rule Engine for Log Events
description: Loads vendor-neutral detection rules written in a simple format and evaluates them over event logs, reporting which rules fired and why, with a test set of known-bad events.

title: Container Runtime Misconfiguration Auditor
description: Inspects running containers for risky settings such as privileged mode, host mounts and added capabilities, and ranks each finding by how far it weakens isolation.

title: Kubernetes RBAC Over-Permission Analyser
description: Reads role bindings from a cluster export, finds identities that can do far more than they use and proposes tighter roles while showing exactly what would stop working.

title: Privacy Impact Assessment Questionnaire Tool
description: Guides a project team through questions about the personal data it collects and produces a structured assessment with identified risks and suggested mitigations.

title: Third-Party Tracker Scanner for Websites
description: Loads pages in a headless browser, lists every third-party request and cookie set before consent, and groups them by company and purpose.

title: Differentially Private Statistics Release Demo
description: Releases summary statistics from a sensitive dataset with calibrated noise, shows how the privacy budget trades accuracy for protection and demonstrates a reconstruction attack on unprotected releases.

title: Timing Attack Demonstration and Constant-Time Comparison
description: Shows how response-time differences can leak a secret one character at a time against a naive comparison, then fixes it with constant-time comparison and measures the difference.

title: Passkey Login with WebAuthn
description: Adds passwordless sign-in using hardware-backed credentials, covering registration, authentication, multiple devices per user and account recovery without a password.

title: Dockerfile Linter and Image Size Optimiser
description: Reads Dockerfiles, flags common problems such as unpinned bases and cache-busting layer order, and shows how each suggested change affects the built image size.

title: Terraform Drift Detector with Scheduled Reports
description: Compares deployed cloud resources with their declared infrastructure code on a schedule, reports differences with who or what changed them and files a ticket for each.

title: Kubernetes Pod Resource Right-Sizing Advisor
description: Analyses historical CPU and memory use of workloads and recommends requests and limits that avoid both waste and throttling, with a simulation of the cost saving.

title: Zero-Downtime Database Migration Pipeline
description: Applies schema changes in backward-compatible steps with expand and contract migrations, and proves with automated tests that the running application keeps working at each step.

title: Pipeline Cache and Build Time Optimiser
description: Instruments continuous integration runs, identifies slow steps and ineffective caches and measures how dependency caching and parallel jobs change total build time.

title: Secrets Rotation Automation for Cloud Credentials
description: Rotates database passwords and API keys on a schedule without downtime by creating the new secret, switching consumers and retiring the old one, with an audit trail.

title: Log-Based Alerting Rules Tester
description: Replays recorded log streams through alert rules to check what would have fired, how often and how late, so rules can be tuned before they page anyone at night.

title: Service Level Objective and Error Budget Dashboard
description: Computes availability and latency objectives from request metrics, shows how much error budget remains this month and projects when it will run out at the current rate.

title: Distributed Tracing for a Microservice Demo
description: Instruments a small set of services with trace context propagation and uses the traces to find which service adds the most latency under load.

title: Circuit Breaker and Retry Policy Lab
description: Simulates a flaky downstream service and compares retries, timeouts and circuit breakers on latency and failure spread, showing how naive retries can make an outage worse.

title: Environment Configuration Drift Checker
description: Compares configuration files across development, staging and production, highlights differences that look accidental and ignores values that should legitimately differ.

title: Cloud Resource Tagging Compliance Auditor
description: Scans cloud accounts for resources missing required ownership and cost tags, reports offenders by team and suggests owners from creation history.

title: Spot Instance Interruption Handler
description: Runs batch jobs on discounted interruptible machines, checkpoints progress on warning notices and resumes elsewhere, measuring cost saved against time lost.

title: Blue-Green Database Credentials Rollover Demo
description: Demonstrates switching an application to new database credentials with zero failed requests, using dual-credential periods and health checks at each stage.

title: Container Image Build Reproducibility Checker
description: Builds the same image twice, compares the results layer by layer and tracks down sources of non-determinism such as timestamps and unpinned packages.

title: Capacity Planning Model from Load Test Results
description: Fits a simple model to load test results to estimate when a service will saturate, and recommends how many instances are needed for a forecast traffic peak.

title: Feature Branch Environment Cost Tracker
description: Tracks how long temporary environments stay running per branch, estimates their cost and nudges owners to shut down ones that have been idle.

title: Service Dependency Map from Network Flows
description: Builds a map of which services talk to which from flow records, highlights unexpected connections and shows the blast radius if one service fails.

title: Runbook Automation Engine
description: Turns written operational runbooks into executable steps with approvals, dry-run mode and a log of what ran, so routine incident actions are consistent and reviewable.

title: Incident Timeline Builder from Alerts and Chat
description: Merges alerts, deploys and chat messages into one timeline of an outage and drafts a post-incident review with the key events and durations filled in.

title: Dependency Update Bot with Safe Merge Rules
description: Opens pull requests for outdated dependencies, groups related updates, runs tests and merges only those that meet defined risk rules, with a record of every decision.

title: Multi-Environment Helm Chart with Policy Checks
description: Packages an application as a parameterised chart for several environments and validates each rendered result against policy rules before it can be deployed.

title: Edge Cache Hit Ratio Analyser
description: Analyses CDN logs to find which content is rarely cached, explains likely reasons such as cache-busting query strings and estimates the bandwidth saved by fixing them.

title: Cold Start Latency Study for Serverless Functions
description: Measures cold and warm start times for functions across runtimes, memory sizes and package sizes, and publishes guidance on what actually changes startup latency.

title: Terraform Module Test Harness
description: Tests infrastructure modules by creating them in a temporary account, asserting on what was created and always destroying it afterwards, with cost limits on every run.

title: Git Hooks Toolkit for Commit Quality
description: Provides pre-commit hooks that check message format, run fast tests and block large files, with a shared configuration that new contributors install in one command.

title: AR Shelf Wayfinder for Library Books
description: Guides a visitor to a book's shelf with on-screen arrows anchored to the building and highlights the exact shelf level once they arrive, using the catalogue's location data.

title: AR Solar System Scale Explorer
description: Places the planets in a room at a true relative scale that learners can walk through, with sizes and distances switchable so the vast emptiness of space becomes visible.

title: Real-Time Occlusion Demo for AR Objects
description: Makes virtual objects appear behind real furniture using depth sensing, and compares how convincing the effect is with and without depth-based occlusion.

title: VR Reaction Time and Attention Test Bench
description: Measures how quickly a user responds to stimuli in different parts of the visual field in VR, logging results per session so changes over time can be compared.

title: VR Comfort Settings Study for Locomotion
description: Implements teleport, smooth movement and vignette options in one scene and collects short comfort ratings so designers can see which choices suit which users.

title: VR Language Practice Market Scene
description: Places learners in a simulated market where they must buy items by speaking the target language, with speech recognition and instant feedback on pronunciation targets.

title: Hand-Tracking Piano Practice in AR
description: Shows falling note guides on a real keyboard through the headset and uses hand tracking to check which keys were pressed, scoring timing accuracy per phrase.

title: Virtual Gallery with Procedural Layout
description: Generates an exhibition space automatically from a list of artworks, balancing walking routes, viewing distance and lighting, and lets a curator adjust the result.

title: AR Product Colour and Finish Visualiser
description: Lets shoppers preview paint colours or materials on real walls and objects with lighting-aware rendering, and compares appearance under different room lighting.

title: VR Cognitive Load Dashboard for Training Scenarios
description: Collects head movement, gaze and task timing during a VR training run and summarises where trainees hesitated, supporting debrief discussion rather than automated judgement.

title: AR Origami Folding Guide
description: Overlays the next fold on a paper model step by step with animated arrows, advancing automatically when the fold is detected as complete.

title: VR Historical Timeline Walkthrough
description: Lets visitors walk along a timeline where each era is a small room with objects and short narration, with events linked to maps and sources.

title: AR Cable and Port Labeller for Server Rooms
description: Recognises tagged ports and cables and overlays their labels and connection destinations, so technicians can trace a cable without opening spreadsheets.

title: Spatial Audio Soundscape Experience
description: Builds an environment where sound sources move and reflect in rooms, and tests whether listeners can locate sources correctly with different audio settings.

title: Multi-User AR Whiteboard with Shared Anchors
description: Lets several people draw on the same virtual surface in a room from their own devices, keeping everyone's view aligned through shared spatial anchors.

title: VR Study of Presence and Embodiment with Avatars
description: Compares how strongly users feel present when their avatar is a floating hand, full body or abstract shape, using a questionnaire and movement data.

title: AR Garden Planner with Sun Path Simulation
description: Lets a user place plants in a real garden and shows how sunlight and shade will fall across the day and season, warning when a plant is in the wrong spot.

title: VR Circuit Building Lab
description: Lets students assemble simple circuits with virtual components and see current and voltage animate, with mistakes such as short circuits explained rather than just failing.

title: AR Subtitles for Spoken Conversations
description: Displays live captions near the speaker's position in view using direction of arrival from microphone arrays, and evaluates readability in a noisy room.

title: VR Virtual Wardrobe Fitting Room
description: Fits garment models to an adjustable body shape and shows how fabric drapes and moves, comparing sizes side by side from the user's own measurements.

title: Gaze-Controlled Menu System for Hands-Free VR
description: Implements menus selected by looking and dwelling, compares dwell times and layouts for speed and error rate, and tests with users who cannot use controllers.

title: AR Archaeology Dig Reconstruction Viewer
description: Overlays reconstructed walls and artefacts onto a physical model of a dig site, with layers a user can toggle to compare evidence with interpretation.

title: Particle Filter Localisation Simulator
description: Shows a simulated robot estimating its position on a known map with a particle filter, letting learners change sensor noise and particle count and watch the estimate converge or fail.

title: PID Controller Tuning Lab for a Balancing Beam
description: Builds a ball-on-beam rig or simulation and lets learners tune proportional, integral and derivative terms, comparing step responses and overshoot for each tuning.

title: A-Star Path Planner Comparison with Costmaps
description: Plans robot routes over occupancy grids with different heuristics and inflated obstacle costs, and compares path length, safety margin and planning time.

title: Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree Planner for a Robot Arm
description: Plans collision-free motions for a multi-joint arm in a cluttered workspace with a randomised tree planner, then smooths the path and tests how often it succeeds.

title: Kalman Filter Sensor Fusion for a Mobile Robot
description: Fuses wheel odometry with an inertial sensor using a Kalman filter and shows how the fused estimate beats either source alone as drift accumulates.

title: Ultrasonic Obstacle Mapping with a Servo Scanner
description: Sweeps an ultrasonic sensor on a servo to build a simple polar map of obstacles and displays it live, noting how sensor beam width blurs object edges.

title: Visual Servoing for Aligning a Gripper to a Target
description: Moves an arm so its camera view of a marker matches a target image, using image feedback directly in the control loop instead of a precomputed position.

title: Robot Task Planner with Behaviour Trees
description: Structures a robot's tasks such as fetch, retry and recover as a behaviour tree, and shows how the tree handles a failed grasp or a blocked corridor.

title: Differential Drive Odometry Calibration Tool
description: Estimates wheel radius and wheelbase errors by driving test patterns and comparing the robot's belief with measured end positions, then applies the corrections.

title: Robot Fleet Charging Scheduler
description: Decides when each robot in a small fleet should return to charge so tasks are still finished on time, comparing simple rules with an optimised schedule in simulation.

title: Soft Gripper Force Sensing Experiment
description: Builds a compliant gripper with flex sensors and measures how grip force relates to sensor readings across objects of different stiffness and shape.

title: Occupancy Grid Mapping from Range Sensors
description: Builds a map of a simulated room from range readings with probabilistic occupancy updates and compares how sensor noise and robot speed affect map quality.

title: Robot Arm Inverse Kinematics Visualiser
description: Computes joint angles for a two- and three-link arm to reach a target, shows the multiple solutions and where the arm reaches singular positions.

title: Wall-Following Maze Robot with Wheel Encoders
description: Navigates a maze by following walls, uses wheel encoders to measure distances and records the walls it has seen to avoid repeating dead ends.

title: Human-Aware Navigation with Personal Space Costs
description: Adds costs around people in a simulated corridor so the robot passes at a comfortable distance and speed, and evaluates how much extra path length this requires.

title: Sim-to-Real Gap Study for a Wheeled Robot
description: Trains a controller in simulation, runs it on a physical robot and measures how performance drops, then tests whether adding noise and randomisation during training narrows the gap.

title: Servo Smooth Motion Profiler
description: Generates trapezoidal and S-curve motion profiles for a servo and compares jerk, vibration and travel time with an abrupt move to the same target.

title: Pick and Place Cycle Time Optimiser
description: Reorders pick and place sequences and tunes speeds to shorten the cycle time of a small robot arm, checking each change against collision and drop-rate limits.

title: Autonomous Rover Energy Budget Planner
description: Plans routes for a solar-powered rover by trading distance, slope and sunlight against battery state, and compares plans against a shortest-path baseline.

title: Robotic Camera Slider for Time-Lapse Photography
description: Moves a camera along a rail at precisely timed steps for time-lapse sequences, with easing curves and a user interface to set duration and distance.

title: Multi-Robot Task Allocation by Auction
description: Assigns tasks to several simulated robots through bidding rounds and compares the result and communication cost with a central optimiser as tasks and failures increase.

title: Robot Safety Zone Monitor with Speed and Separation Limits
description: Slows or stops a robot arm when a person enters defined zones, based on distance and relative speed, and tests that the stop happens within a calculated safe distance.
